item.title: Falcons Show Fight in Comeback Win Over Tampa
item.description: The Falcons were reduced to playing spoiler after being eliminated from playoff contention following a home blowout loss to Seattle last week. They apparently relish the role. The Falcons put together their most thrilling win of the season Thursday night in Tampa, beating the Buccaneers 29-28 on a 43-yard field goal by Zane Gonzalez on the game’s final play. item.title: Bradley Central Defensive Lineman AJ Westfield Signs With Tulane
item.description: Cleveland, TN-(WDEF-TV) Bradley Central defensive lineman AJ Westfield signed with Tulane on Friday afternoon. Westfield is listed as a three-star recruit. The Green Wave of course made the college football playoffs, and Westfield is glad they’ve settled on their new head coach. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Local High School All Star Football Game Set For Saturday
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) We’ve got a local high school all star football game Saturday afternoon at Boyd Buchanan. Kickoff is at 2pm. The Chattanooga area all star game gives several area kids one last time to wear that high school uniform. Rhea county assistant Brandon Ashby is one of the head coaches, and he’s digging the talent pool this year. Categories: Sports...

item.title: Bearettes Down Rival Cleveland 59-50
item.description: Cleveland, TN-(WDEF-TV) The Cleveland girls basketball team hung with district giant Bradley Central all night, but the Bearettes still managed another victory in the rivalry by a final of 59-50. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Ridgeland Girls Continue to Enjoy Impressive Turnaround With a Victory Over Heritage
item.description: Rossville, GA-(WDEF-TV) The Ridgeland girls basketball team won only 5 games last season. Must feel like a distant memory now. On Friday they defeated Heritage 53-43 for their 8th win of the season. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Cleveland Edges Bradley Central 49-46
item.description: Cleveland, TN-(WDEF-TV) Bradley Central opened with a 17-3 lead over rival Cleveland. But the Blue Raiders kept battling, and they edged their cross-town rival by a final of 49-46. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
